NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed 3 more times: formatting, an extra fixture, and an updated description and checklist. CI now passes, which was the feedback's ask. Nothing links this PR to an issue.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | CI is passing, which answers the feedback about the test suite errors. |
| ❌  | No linked issue and no "Fixes: #N" in the description, so we can't confirm the work is on a "help wanted" issue. |
| ℹ️  | The author has no merged PRs, and an earlier PR of theirs (#40356) was closed for not following the PR guidelines and the AI policy. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link the issue they are fixing. If there is none, or it isn't labeled "help wanted", this becomes a close candidate.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, CI looks good now. Could you link the issue this fixes with "Fixes: #N" in the description? Per our [contributing guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html), we only accept PRs for issues labeled "help wanted".
```
